tactics: intro h <;> induction h generalizing l₁ l₂

rintro h <;> induction h generalizing l₁ l₂ with
  | slnil => exact ⟨[], [], rfl, by simp_all, by simp_all⟩
  | cons a _ ih => obtain ⟨r₁, r₂, rfl, h₁, h₂⟩ := ih l₁ l₂ hl; exact ⟨a :: r₁, r₂, rfl, h₁.cons a, h₂⟩
  | cons₂ a _ ih => cases l₁ with
    | nil => subst hl; exact ⟨[], _, rfl, List.Sublist.slnil, by simp_all⟩
    | cons b l₁ => simp at hl; obtain ⟨rfl, hl⟩ := hl; obtain ⟨r₁, r₂, rfl, h₁, h₂⟩ := ih l₁ l₂ hl; exact ⟨b :: r₁, r₂, rfl, h₁.cons₂ b, h₂⟩
